chapters.label: Wembley, 2024
chapters.text: Wembley, 2024, Champions League final. Real Madrid have a free kick, and Dortmund line up their wall. Toni Kroos curls it toward the top corner... but Gregor Kobel flies! Fingertips! Wide!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Kobel stays on his toes. One quick step, a big push, and his fingertips turn it past the post.

chapters.label: Start the attack
chapters.text: This is how Kobel starts attacks. He catches it, and looks up fast. Who is free? He throws it out, and Dortmund are away! After a save, look up fast, and pass to a free teammate.
